name: Humantay Lake
why: A turquoise lake under the Humantay glacier, an hour and a half above the road: the best day trip from Cusco after Machu Picchu.
book: Tours from Cusco at 04:30; community fee at Soraypampa (cash).
dangers: The climb goes from 3,900 to 4,200 m in an hour: slow down.

points.name: Soraypampa under Nevado Salkantay
points.note: The road end and the camps at 3,900 m, Salkantay's snow peak above; vans from Cusco stop here.

points.name: Humantay moraine path
points.note: The steep zigzags up the moraine; horses for those who need them.

points.name: Humantay Lake
points.note: About 4,200 m, a turquoise lake under the Humantay glacier. Climb the ridge to the left for the view from above.
